title: Fix docs/qa/legacy/00-testing-methodology.md §9 document index — none of the listed filenames exist
why: The actual files in the same directory are 01-product-overview.md, 02-auth-and-accounts.md, 03-onboarding.md ... 13-settings.md, 14-sync-and-offline.md — a different naming scheme, order, and count than the table's 18 rows (01-auth.md through 18-settings.md). §9's own instruction ('open 01-auth.md and begin') sends a tester to a file that exists nowhere in the repo.
recommendation: Regenerate §9's table from the real docs/qa/legacy/ directory listing.
acceptance_criteria: Every filename in §9's table exists at docs/qa/legacy/<name> and the row order matches the numeric prefix.
